title: Havooch settings
description: config.toml for Havooch, the video player for giving feedback to agents. The file lives in $XDG_CONFIG_HOME/havooch/ (default ~/.config/havooch/); with HAVOOCH_SUPPORT_DIR set, in its config/ folder. Every key takes its default when it is missing, and Havooch rejects a file that sets any key without version = 1. Havooch applies each save at once, keeps the last valid settings when a save has a problem, and writes its verdict to config-status.json in its support folder; `havooch config check` gives the same verdict without the app. An unknown key is a warning in the app and an error here.

version.description: The format version. Only 1 exists. Havooch needs it in a file that sets any other key.

theme.description: The pinned theme, by its name, as `havooch theme list` prints it: a built-in theme or one of yours in themes/ beside this file. Leave it out to follow the Mac's light or dark appearance. `havooch theme set` writes this key.

projects.description: The projects: the versions of one video each, in order. An agent makes one with `havooch project new` and adds a version with `havooch project add`.

slug.description: The project's name in commands: lowercase letters, digits and single hyphens, 1 to 64 characters, unique in the file.

title.description: The name people read. Leave it out to show the slug.

versions.description: The versions, v1 first. The videos stay where they are.

path.description: The video file: an absolute path, or one that starts with ~/ for the home folder.

label.description: A few words on what changed in this version.
